scope: Planning-only audit of all current tools-layer files and their consumers; no production changes or release reacceptance.

method.reading: Read every source file including private/local helpers, public properties and options; cross-check tests and upper-layer adapters.
method.declarations: Lexical declaration/property/option index for snapshot traceability, not a MATLAB AST or proof of every dynamic call.
method.references: Qualified textual references outside full-line comments. Strings and inline comments may remain. Not a runtime dependency count; unqualified private calls were reviewed manually.
limits: No performance benchmark or peak-memory measurement was run during this planning audit.
No greater-than-2GB allocation was attempted; MAT-v7 risk is inferred from source and local official R2025b save help.
No formal whole-project call graph or strongly connected component proof was produced.
Native observations use Windows R2025b; other platforms/releases remain unverified.
Native probes are observations and contract probes, not newly passing regression tests or fixes.

native.scope: Read-only planning audit probes; findings are observations, not source repairs.

observation.classification: Contract decision: ratio representability versus mathematical definition.

independentHashOracle.conclusion: Java uint8 conversion preserves these bytes; the reproduced defect is hexadecimal formatting, not a demonstrated raw-byte collision.

matV7SourceEvidence.interpretation: >=2GB variables require -v7.3; unsupported items can be skipped with a warning. writeRecord currently does not verify the temporary variable inventory before committing. Static documented risk, not an executed large-allocation test.

secondReview.scope: Independent foundations, IO and visual review; root analysis review and cross-contract reconciliation.
correctedDesignPoints: Heterogeneous object arrays preserve per-element class semantics.
String missing mask remains elementwise, with empty-shape JSON compatibility.
Nonuniform plots preserve final row/column and physical sample meaning.
Finalized observers retain vetoed figure ownership; reset cannot drop them.
Legacy hold-off replacement and compatibility tests remain explicit exceptions.
Open configuration/defaults/duplicate keys distinguish transition from strict target.
Predecode budgets distinguish parser allocation, decoded arrays and sparse CSC overhead.
Task DAG/file coverage checked after concurrent document updates.
